fixes.text: 1) VERDICT: Acme Fresh Market is a regional grocery chain headquartered in Akron, Ohio. 2) WHY: Formally known as The Fred W. Albrecht Grocery Company, it operates 15 stores across Summit, Portage, Stark, and Medina counties in Northeast Ohio. 3) TRAPS: Do not confuse it with national chains; its footprint is strictly local to that specific Ohio region. 4) HOOK: Remember 'Albrecht' for the corporate name and 'Akron' for the base. Exam trap: If asked about its scale, note it is a regional player,

fixes.fix: Explained "In _____, he opened his own store in Akron, called F.W. Albrecht Grocery Company"
fixes.text: 1) VERDICT: 1891. 2) WHY: F.W. Albrecht established his independent grocery store in Akron during this year, marking the origin of what would eventually become the massive Albrecht chain. 3) TRAPS: Do not confuse this founding date with later expansion years or the formation of other regional chains. 4) HOOK: Remember '91' as the year Akron got its first big Albrecht. Exam trap: Questions often swap this date with 1890 or 1892 to test precise recall of business history milestones.

fixes.fix: Explained "After visiting an Acme store in _____ (currently, a supermarket chain owned by Albertsons)"
fixes.text: 1) VERDICT: The answer is Philadelphia. 2) WHY: Albrecht visited an Acme store in Philadelphia and was inspired to rename his own corner grocery store to match the brand. 3) TRAPS: Do not confuse this with other major retail hubs; the specific location cited in the source material is Philadelphia. 4) HOOK: Remember 'Acme' started as a corner store rename after a Philadelphia visit. Exam trap: Albertsons now owns the chain, but the historical inspiration point remains Philadelphia.
